nom: Exuviance Lift Volumizing Hyaluronic Acid Face Concentrate

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report a lightweight, non-greasy feel and a taut, plump effect, with one specifically noting no added stickiness or dryness.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers are split: one found it too tightening and in need of extra moisture, while others, including an older reviewer using it as a night moisturizer, report eased dryness with no irritating residue.
segments.combination: The one reviewer identifying combination skin reports a smooth texture with no breakouts or blemishes and a plumper look.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are divided: several report no irritation or breakouts and call the formula gentle, while others experienced irritation, breakouts, or a too-tightening feel.
segments.mature: Reviewers who mention getting older or aging-related dryness report the serum eased dryness and left skin feeling firmer with somewhat softer fine lines, without irritating residue.

concerns.aging: Most reviewers report smoother-looking fine lines and smile lines and a subtle lifting or plumping effect with consistent use over several weeks; a notable number, including some using it for three or more weeks, instead report no visible lifting, firming, or difference at all.
concerns.dehydration: The majority of reviewers report a clear boost in hydration and plumpness, with several saying dryness or tightness improved; a couple of reviewers with dry or sensitive skin instead found it too tightening or drying.
concerns.barrier: Most reviewers, including several with sensitive skin, report no irritation, burning, or allergic reaction and describe the formula as gentle; a few reviewers experienced burning or an allergic reaction, in one case severe enough to stop use.
concerns.blemishes: Nearly all reviewers who mention breakouts report none, including some with acne-prone or combination skin; one reviewer with sensitive, acne-prone skin, however, describes new breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers across skin types, including one with oily skin, describe the formula as non-greasy and quick to absorb; one reviewer, however, reports their skin became oilier faster after starting use.

aspects.libelle: Pump dispenser often broken or missing the inner tube
Strong, chemical or playdough-like initial scent
Premium-feeling packaging with a locking lid
Layers smoothly under makeup and other skincare
Small amount needed, bottle lasts for months
Feels expensive relative to results for some users

extraits.titre: Not for my dry sensative skin
extraits.texte: I received this product in exchange for my honest review, I wanted to like this but honestly it just wasnt for me. It felt too tightening on my skin and i felt like I needed extra moisture. It also seemed a lot more fragrant than I prefer on my facial products. This maybe better on aged skin who need a little more tightening but for me it was a little too much. I did enjoy thr consistency of the product.

extraits.titre: A little goes a long way, but it didn't improve my lines and
extraits.texte: I've been using the Lift Volumizing Hyaluronic Acid Face Concentrate for almost a month, but unfortunately I haven't seen any improvement in my fine lines. I have very sensitive skin, and this product caused more irritation than I expected. A little does go a long way, but even with careful use it still wasn't the right fit for my skin. I'm sure it works wonderfully for some people, though. The packaging is lovely, and I appreciated that it had very little scent, which is great for those who are sensitive to fragrances.

I really wanted to love this lifting facial cream because it delivers on its promise of firmer, smoother-looking skin. The texture is rich but absorbs well, and I noticed a visible tightening effect after consistent use. My skin looked more refreshed and lifted. The only downside: it caused breakouts for me. If you have sensitive or acne-prone skin, this might be something to keep in mind.

extraits.titre: My new go-to night time moisturizer
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Now that I'm getting older the dry skin from cooler weather emphasizes any fine lines. I love this cream and I use it as a night time moisturizer. It absorbs into my skin instantly and doesn't leave behind an irritating residue like other facial creams. Once I apply the product, my skin is left feeling moisturized and rejuvenated. I especially love the locking mechanism on the lid so that it doesn't leak during travel or storage.

I'm someone who has tried a lotttt of products. Oily skin, early 20's, type IV on the Fitzpatrick scale. This keeps my skin taut and plump. I definitely noticed a difference after using it. "Natural Filler" is a pretty darn accurate way to explain this products effect. And the amount you get/usage over time lasts for a while, for me, I got it three-four months ago and still have over 3/4 of the bottle left. I will definitely be buying and trying more Exuviance products!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Loved this product! It's very lightweight and absorbed well into my skin. I have sensitive acne prone skin and Im glad this didn't make me break out! It's gentle yet effective. I noticed some lines fade away. I also love the packaging. It's nice and an easy to use bottle.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Do you see this skin? The texture is smooth but not cracked and dry? No breakouts or blemishes? I cannot believe the difference this concentrate has made on my combination skin! It's not irritating at all but makes my skin look so plump and smooth! Will have to get again!
